overlay.$description: Corner radius of the modal and slideover panel (BR-12 look, ADR-0029). TBD-10: "rounded" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Outline stroke width of the modal and slideover panel, and of the lines between its header, body, and footer (BR-13).

bg.$description: Fill of the modal and slideover panel: the pure black page (BR-03, ADR-0053), through `color.surface.elevated`. It is separated from the page by its outline, never by a different fill (C-05).

highlight.$description: The neon highlight of the modal and slideover panel: its outline is brand pink, like the cards (BR-01, BR-12, ADR-0018). Chosen by the owner in ADR-0029.

divider.$description: Color of the lines between the header, body, and footer of the modal and slideover: brand pink, like the outline (ADR-0018, ADR-0029).

scrim.$description: Color of the backdrop that dims the page behind a modal or slideover: pure black (BR-03). How much of it shows is overlay.scrimOpacity. Chosen by the owner in ADR-0029.

scrimOpacity.$description: How much of the backdrop color covers the page, from 0 to 1: 0.85, black at 85% (ADR-0054, ADR-0029).

shadow.$description: Elevation shadow of the modal and slideover panel: none. The outline lifts the panel off the black page, and there is no shadow in the system (ADR-0054).

z.$description: Stacking order of the modal and slideover backdrop and panel: 50 (ADR-0054). A toast sits above it.

fg.$description: Title and body text of the modal and slideover.

fgMuted.$description: Description text of the modal and slideover.
